model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of expenditure over the reference value from 2021, and the increase between 2021 and 2024, for various European countries. The horizontal axis displays the names of the countries, listed alphabetically from Polen to Spanien, and the vertical axis represents the percentage of expenditure over the reference value, ranging from 0% to 4% with tick intervals of 1%. The value axis is linear and labeled in increments of 0.5%, with the scale starting at 0%. The bars are grouped by color, with green representing the “Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024” (increase between 2021 and 2024), yellow representing “Ausgaben 2021” (expenditure 2021), and a lighter shade of green representing “1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021” (1.5% over the reference value from 2021). The tallest bar, representing Polen, has a value of approximately 3.5%, with the “Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024” portion reaching a value of approximately 1.2%. The shortest bar, representing Luxemburg, has a value of approximately 0.5%, with the “Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024” portion reaching a value of approximately 0.2%.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
